parts.label: b
parts.tolerance: Show that k = (1/2) ln 4 (answer given). Accept also k = ln 2 (since (1/2) ln 4 = ln 2).
parts.notes: M1 for substituting t=2, N=800 to get 800 = 200 e^(2k). A1 for simplifying to e^(2k) = 4. A1 (AG) for taking ln to obtain 2k = ln 4 and dividing by 2.

parts.label: c
parts.description: Find N(5) to the nearest integer.
parts.notes: M1 for substituting t=5 into 200 e^(kt) using k = (1/2) ln 4. A1 for evaluating 4^(5/2) = 32. A1 for N(5) = 200 * 32 = 6400.

parts.label: d
parts.tolerance: Accept exact form t = 2 ln(25)/ln(4) = ln(25)/ln(2) = log_2(25). Numerical: 4.64 (3 s.f.). Graphing-calculator solve methods earn full credit.
parts.notes: M1 for setting 200 e^(kt) = 5000 and isolating to e^(kt) = 25. M1 for taking ln to get t = ln(25)/k. A1 for t ~= 4.64 hours (3 s.f.). M1+M1 may also be awarded for a GDC-based solve.

parts.label: e
parts.description: Find the doubling time of the culture (3 s.f.).
parts.tolerance: Accept exact form t = 1 hour (since k = ln 2 makes ln 2 / k = 1 exactly). Numerical: 1.00 (3 s.f.).
parts.notes: M1 for setting up doubling condition 2 = e^(kt). M1 for isolating t = ln(2)/k = 2 ln 2 / ln 4 = 1. A1 for t = 1.00 hour.

source: original (compound interest: $3000 at 4.5% annual, plus continuous comparison)

parts.label: a
parts.description: Show that value at end of year 1 is $3135.
parts.notes: AG. Direct multiplication; one-line justification expected.

parts.label: b
parts.description: Find value of account after 6 years (nearest dollar).
parts.tolerance: Accept $3907 (rounding 3906.78... to nearest dollar). Accept $3906 if candidate uses the rounded $3135 from (a) and compounds; explain in notes if seen.

parts.label: c
parts.description: Find smallest n for value to first exceed $5000.
parts.notes: M1 for setting 3000 (1.045)^n > 5000 (or equivalent inequality). M1 for taking log/ln of both sides to isolate n. A1 for n = 12 (smallest integer satisfying the inequality). Accept GDC table-based approach: M1+M1 for tabulating V(11) and V(12), A1 for n = 12.

parts.label: d
parts.description: Find value after 6 years with continuous compounding at 4.5%; state difference between accounts.
parts.tolerance: Accept continuous value $3929.88 (rounding 3929.8838 to nearest cent). Accept difference $23.10 or $23.11 depending on intermediate rounding (unrounded subtraction yields 23.10; subtracting rounded values may give 23.11). Accept both.
parts.notes: M1 for setting up A(6) = 3000 e^0.27. A1 for $3929.88. M1 for computing the difference. A1 for difference value ($23.10 or $23.11). A1 for stating both account values to the nearest cent (presentation mark).
parts.follow_through: Award the second M1 and A1 for difference even if candidate's value in (b) was incorrect — accept any difference computed correctly from candidate's annual value and the continuous value.

source: original (radioactive decay: cesium-137, half-life 30 yrs, M_0 = 64 g)

parts.label: a
parts.tolerance: Accept 20.2 g (3 s.f.). Accept also 20.16 with rounding mention. Exact form 64 * 2^(-5/3) acceptable as intermediate.
parts.notes: M1 for substituting t=50 into 64 (0.5)^(t/30) to get 64 (0.5)^(5/3). A1 for 20.2 g (3 s.f.). Units 'g' or 'grams' should be present but absence is not penalised.

parts.label: b
parts.description: Find time when mass has decayed to 8 g.
parts.tolerance: Accept 90 years (exact). Recognising that 8 = 64/8 = 1/8 of initial = (1/2)^3 of initial leads to t/30 = 3 directly.
parts.notes: M1 for setting 64 (0.5)^(t/30) = 8 and recognising (0.5)^(t/30) = 1/8 = (0.5)^3 (or for taking log of both sides). A1 for t = 90 years.

parts.label: c
parts.description: Find time after which only 5% of original mass remains (nearest year).
parts.tolerance: Accept 130 years (rounding 129.66... to nearest year). Accept exact form t = 30 ln(0.05)/ln(0.5) or 30 log_(1/2)(0.05).
parts.notes: M1 for recognising 5% remaining means M(t) = 3.2 (or for setting (0.5)^(t/30) = 0.05). M1 for taking log of both sides to isolate t/30 = ln(0.05)/ln(0.5). A1 for t = 130 years (nearest year, from 129.66...).

parts.label: a
parts.tolerance: Accept 86°C, 86 degrees C, or 86 (with implied units).

parts.label: b
parts.tolerance: Accept 22°C, 22 degrees C, or 22 (with implied units).
parts.notes: A1 for 22°C. The asymptote of T(t) as t -> infinity is 22, which is the room temperature.

parts.label: c
parts.tolerance: Show that k = (1/4) ln 2 (answer given). Accept also k = ln(2^(1/4)) or k = (ln 2)/4.
parts.notes: M1 for substituting t=4, T=54 to get 54 = 22 + 64 e^(-4k) and isolating to 64 e^(-4k) = 32. A1 for e^(-4k) = 1/2. A1 (AG) for taking ln to get -4k = -ln 2 and dividing by -4.

parts.label: d
parts.tolerance: Accept 33.3°C (3 s.f.). Accept exact form 22 + 8 sqrt(2). Accept 33.31 with rounding mention.
parts.notes: M1 for substituting t=10 into 22 + 64 e^(-kt) using k = (1/4) ln 2. A1 for evaluating to exact form 22 + 8 sqrt(2) (or numerical 33.314). A1 for 33.3°C (3 s.f.).

parts.label: e
parts.notes: M1 for setting 22 + 64 e^(-kt) = 30 and isolating to e^(-kt) = 1/8. M1 for taking ln to get t = 3 ln 2 / k = 3 ln 2 / ((1/4) ln 2) = 12. A1 for t = 12 minutes.
